overviewParagraphs: Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort is Vietnam's island golf showcase — a spectacular tropical course on Phu Quoc Island where the South China Sea serves as the defining visual backdrop and strategic companion throughout the round. Located in one of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing resort destinations, it combines pristine natural beauty with championship-standard conditioning.

The layout hugs the coastline, with several holes played directly along the ocean's edge rewarding bold play with unforgettable vistas. The vegetation is lush, raw, and tropical — a deliberate contrast to the manicured resort aesthetic found at many competitor layouts, giving Vung Bau an authentic, adventurous character.

For discerning golfers extending their Vietnam itinerary to include Phu Quoc Island, Eschuri Vung Bau is the natural headline course. AGS can build full island packages incorporating golf, beach resorts, and island excursions for extended Vietnam travel experiences.

curatorBriefHtml: Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Phu Quoc, Vietnam, crafted by IMG / Steven McFarlane (2024) and stretching to 6,865 Yards (Blue Tees) across a ocean-front, south china sea environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its coastal island rainforest environment (Pristine coastal jungle canopy) and pristine paspalum conditioning (Smooth tournament greens).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort (Phu Quoc International Airport) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie island hospitality & warmth (Attentive personalized service), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Phu Quoc golf tour by AGS, Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort provides a distinct architectural test by IMG / Steven McFarlane that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort in Phu Quoc, Vietnam is a Par 72 championship layout designed by IMG / Steven McFarlane (opened 2024), measuring 6,865 Yards (Blue Tees) within a ocean-front, south china sea setting. It is particularly noted for coastal island rainforest environment (Pristine coastal jungle canopy).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort operates under phu quoc international airport protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (caddie island hospitality & warmth (Attentive personalized service)), and private VIP transfers from your Phu Quoc hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort's pristine paspalum conditioning (Smooth tournament greens) alongside coastal island rainforest environment (Pristine coastal jungle canopy). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort?
faqs.a: November through April is the best season for Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort on Phu Quoc Island.
